title: Document Intake
summary: Invoices, POs and applications extracted, validated against source systems, and routed — exceptions to humans.

trigger.description: Document arrives by email attachment or upload folder.

agents.name: extractor
agents.role: Reads the document and extracts the structured record (parties, line items, totals, dates).

agents.name: validator
agents.role: Cross-checks the record against the source system (PO matches, vendor exists, totals cross-foot); flags exceptions with reasons.

agents.name: router
agents.role: Posts clean records to the target system; sends exceptions to the human queue with the failing check named.

rollback: Disable the document.received trigger; unposted records stay in the review queue. erp.write stays gated until 60 days of clean edit-rate history.
